name: dev.pages.domainvet/domainvet
title: DomainVet
description: Domain intel for agents: DNS, RDAP age/registrar, CT certs, security headers, tech stack, sitemaps.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Resolve DNS records for a domain via DNS-over-HTTPS (1.1.1.1): A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT (SPF/verification), CNAME, CAA, SOA, SRV, HTTPS, DS, DNSKEY. Returns values with TTLs, whether the domain exists (NXDOMAIN) and whether the answer was DNSSEC-validated.

types.description: Comma-separated record types (default A,AAAA,MX,NS,TXT,CNAME,CAA,SOA). Also SRV,HTTPS,DS,DNSKEY,PTR

tools.name: rdap_domain
tools.description: Look up a domain's registration record via RDAP (the modern WHOIS): registration date, age in days/years, expiry date and days left, registrar, status flags, nameservers and DNSSEC. A domain registered days ago is a strong phishing/scam signal.

tools.name: ssl_certs
tools.description: List unexpired TLS certificates issued for a domain from public Certificate Transparency logs (Cert Spotter, crt.sh fallback): issuer (Let's Encrypt, DigiCert...), names covered, validity window, latest expiry and days remaining. Note: shows issued certs, not necessarily the one being served.

tools.name: security_headers
tools.description: Fetch a URL and grade its HTTP security headers A-F: HSTS (with max-age), Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP. Also flags version-leaking headers (Server, X-Powered-By) and returns all response headers and the redirect chain.

tools.name: tech_detect
tools.description: Identify what a site is built with from its HTML and headers: CMS (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Ghost...), framework (Next.js, Nuxt, Astro...), CDN/hosting (Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify...), analytics, payments, support chat and web server. ~50 fingerprints; heuristic.

tools.name: sitemap_urls
tools.description: Find a site's XML sitemaps (robots.txt Sitemap lines, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml), follow sitemap indexes, and return the page URLs listed. Use it to enumerate a site's pages before reading them.

url.description: Site URL or direct sitemap.xml URL

tools.name: favicon_find
tools.description: Find a website's icons: <link rel=icon / apple-touch-icon / mask-icon> with sizes and types, the default /favicon.ico (verified), the og:image, and the best icon URL to display.
